name: Livermore Police Explorer Post #925
what_you_do: Explorers learn about police work through training, hands-on career activities, leadership roles and community service.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 (and done with 8th grade) to 21. Your application must arrive before your 19th birthday. You must be in school with at least a 2.0 GPA, have good moral character and no felony convictions, and be interested in a law enforcement career.
duration: Ongoing. The page does not list a meeting schedule.
deadline_text: No application deadline is stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the application from the police Explorer page and send it in. Questions: lpd-explorer@livermoreca.gov.
notes: The police page also says applicants must be free from physical or mental conditions that could put themselves or others in danger on an assignment. The library's youth programs list adds 'Live or attend school in Livermore', but the police page itself does not say that, so ask. The application PDF itself was not opened. Pages were read with firecrawl because livermoreca.gov blocks plain fetches.
